title: insight_dismissals row
description: One row of `insight_dismissals` as stored in a .zwallet payload. Mirrors sql/client-schema.sql.

id.description: UUIDv7, or UUIDv8 for SMS/seed/deterministic rows (ADR 0010).

hlc.description: HLC of the last write = max over field_hlc (ADR 0009).

field_hlc.description: JSON object {merge_group: hlc} encoded as a string.

created_at.description: Epoch ms. Immutable; merge keeps the minimum.

updated_at.description: Epoch ms. Merge keeps the maximum.

deleted_at.description: Epoch ms tombstone; null when live. Only the `deleted` group changes it.
